{{Quote|From Tython, the children of the Je'daii spread out across the Tython system. Traveling toward the sun, they settled on Sunspot and Malterra, Nox, and arid Krev Coeur.|[[Ketu]]|<ref name="DotJ1" />}}
'''Tythos''' was a [[Star/Legends|star]] in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] that was located within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region. The star was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by eleven [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], the birthplace of the mystic [[Je'daii Order]]. Tythos appeared from [[Realspace/Legends|space]] to be yellow-orange in [[Color/Legends|color]]. More than a [[Time/Legends|millennium]] after the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[36,453 BBY]], the non&ndash;[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Tythan|settlers]] of Tython traveled toward the planet's sun and colonized the innermost planets of the [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. Tythos could be seen from the worlds of Tython and Shikaakwa on several occasions during the subsequent thousands of years, and by [[25,793 BBY]], the [[Je'daii Temple Master]] [[Kora Ryo]] had made a habit of meditating on Tython before the view of setting Tythos.

==Description==
Tythos was a [[Star/Legends|star]] in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] that was located within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region. The star was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by eleven [[Planet/Legends|planets]]&mdash;hot [[Sunspot (Tython system)|Sunspot]] and [[Malterra]], the two innermost planets that rotated around Tythos in opposite directions, the [[Factory world/Legends|manufacturing world]] of [[Nox (planet)|Nox]], the arid planet [[Krev Coeur]], [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], the birthplace of the mystic [[Je'daii Order]], the important planets of [[Kalimahr/Legends|Kalimahr]] and [[Shikaakwa]], the verdant planet [[Ska Gora]], the gas giants [[Obri]] and [[Mawr]], and, finally, cold [[Furies Gate]], the outermost planet. [[Scientist/Legends|Scientists]] speculated that Sunspot had originally been a rogue [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] that had been captured by the [[Gravity/Legends|gravitational]] pull of Tythos. A number of [[Moon/Legends|moons]] orbited the planets in turn&mdash;[[Ashla (moon)/Legends|Ashla]] and [[Bogan]] circled Tython, Kalimahr had three natural satellites, both Shikaakwa and Ska Gora each had a single moon, while Obri and Mawr, also known as "[[the Giants]]," had three and seven moons, respectively. Following the [[Second migration|settlement]] of the Tython [[Star system/Legends|system]], Furies Gate also acquired a satellite in the form of a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] called [[Fury Station]].<ref name="DotJ0" /> Tythos appeared from [[Realspace/Legends|space]] to be yellow-orange in [[Color/Legends|color]].<ref name="DotJ8">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 3|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 3]]</ref><ref name="TOR1">[[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 5|''The Old Republic — The Lost Suns'' 5]]</ref>

==History==
More than a [[Time/Legends|millennium]] after<ref name="DotJ1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]]</ref> the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[36,453 BBY]],<ref name="Void">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref> the non&ndash;[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Tythan|settlers]] of Tython traveled toward Tythos and colonized the worlds of Sunspot, Malterra, Nox and Krev Coeur.<ref name="DotJ1" /> Tythos could later be seen shining on the temple of [[Stav Kesh]] on Tython on at least two occasions during the subsequent thousands of years,<ref name="DotJ1" /><ref name="DotJ6">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 1]]</ref> and could also be observed from Shikaakwa<ref name="DotJ2">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 2|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 2]]</ref> and from space near Krev Coeur<ref name="DotJ8" /> in [[25,793 BBY]].<ref name="CBR2">{{WebCite|url=https://www.cbr.com/nycc-exclusive-ostrander-and-duursema-unveil-star-wars-dawn-of-the-jedi|text=NYCC EXCLUSIVE: Ostrander and Duursema Unveil "Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi"|archivedate=20200817183352|author=Shaun Manning|date=2011-10-13|quote=[&hellip;] the series really gets going with events just prior to the Force Wars, which began in 25,793 BBY.}}</ref> By that time, the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Je'daii Temple Master]] [[Kora Ryo]] had made a habit of meditating in the temple of [[Kaleth]] before the view of setting Tythos.<ref name="DotJ7">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 2|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 2]]</ref> More than twenty thousand years later, Tythos could be seen in space while [[Theron Shan]]&mdash;a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&mdash;left the world of Tython in [[Sojourner|his starship]].<ref name="TOR1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tythos was first pictured in the entry for Tython in [[The Holonet]] feature of the official website for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''&mdash;a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[BioWare]]. The star was depicted in a schematic of the Tython system. Since its establishment in [[2008]], ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} website has gone through a number of changes, resulting in the removal of some of the features and images that were originally located there, including the aforementioned schematic. Tythos made its first [[in-universe]] appearance in the [[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 5|eleventh]] issue of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic (comic series)|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'']] series of [[Star Wars comic books|comics]] which was published in [[October 12]], 2011, written by [[Alexander Freed]] and penciled by [[Dave Ross]]. The star's name was provided in ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0]]'', a preview issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'' series of comics. The issue was published on [[February 1]], [[2012]], and was written by [[John Ostrander]] and penciled by [[Jan Duursema]]. Tythos also appeared in the [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|first]], the [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 2|second]], the [[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 1|sixth]], the [[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 2|seventh]] and the [[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 3|eighth]] issue of the series&mdash;published on [[February 15]], [[March 21]], [[November 28]] and [[December 19]] of year 2012 and [[February 27]] of year [[2013]], respectively&mdash;and also received a mention in the short story ''[[Eruption]]'' that was authored by Ostrander and published in the [[Star Wars Insider 141|one-hundred-forty-first issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine.
